programmes.d: Andy Brown and some children feed some birds and watch them playing on the bird table. In Teletubbyland, it's timer for Tubby Custard, but Dipsy spills his all over a Tubby Seat. No-one wants to sit in the Tubby Custard, so Noo-Noo tidies it up.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies watch some children who love to skip. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies practice skipping. To begin with they’re not very good, but after lots of practice, they skip all over Teletubbyland.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The Teletubbies watch some Spanish children picking chillies. In Teletubbyland the Tubby Toast machine wasn’t working. Tubby Toast flies everywhere.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.

The Teletubbies go up the slide to see two children help mend a dry stone wall. A wall appears in Teletubbyland. Laa-Laa, Po and Tinky Winky play a game with the wall. They hear Dipsy coming and hide behind the wall.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
The Teletubbies say eh-oh, then laugh as they fall over. They get up to watch some children have fun playing on a huge pile of cushions.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
Teletubbies lobe to play peek-a-boo. The Teletubbies watch some children painting pictures. When a book appears in Teletubbyland, something magic happens when Dipsy turns the pages.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
The Teletubbies watch some children taking photographs of each other's faces. Dipsy has a good look around Teletubbyland when a telescope appears.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.
Po jumps out from behind Tinky Winky and they run off to watch Andy Brown and some children looking for creatures. They find some woodlice under a log.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song to Dipsy and Po, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.
Tinky Winky has no time for Tubby Custard before watching some children feed some baby penguins. The Lion & Bear appear in Teletubbyland.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.
The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.
The Teletubbies play a hello and goodbye game in the hills. They watch a little boy look for a chameleon in the garden
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
Dipsy goes for a walk and sees lots of things in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch as Andy Brown shows some children a rockpool. There's time for one more dance before Tubby Bye Bye.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies walk about Teletubbyland in a huddle, before watching a little girl with lots of puppies. Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep and comes to Teletubbyland to find them.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.

The Teletubbies have fun saying 'Boo! ' The Teletubbies watch some children riding on a bus when it gets washed. A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa. There's time for one more dance before Tubby Bye Bye.
The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.
The Teletubbies watch some children going for a walk to look for dandelion clocks to blow. Po decides to have a blowy day and has fun blowing at everything in Teletubbyland.
In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po.
Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits.
In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky was asleep, Dipsy was making some adjustments and Laa-Laa was eating Tubby Toast. But nobody knew what Po was doing.
A voice trumpet rises and teaches Laa-Laa to count to six. The Teletubbies watch some children sing and act out the nursery rhyme ‘Sing a Song of Sixpence’.
Dancing; children paint pictures and patterns on eggs; magical tree appears.
The Teletubbies love to watch children. Today, they see Ella and Lilly who tell us about their dog – called Alice. A dog appears in Teletubbyland.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.
The Tubbies watch an international Christmas insert. Laa-Laa makes a snowball. Her snowball begins to roll and it gets bigger and bigger.
Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.

The Teletubbies watch a little boy and older friend playing a tune on a piano. In Teletubbyland, a piano appears. Tinky Winky and Po both have great fun bashing away at the keys, but when they play nicely, they play a lovely tune.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
All four Teletubbies pop up to say hello. The Teletubbies watch some children joining in with Debbie. Laa-Laa makes up a song, which makes the other Teletubbies run away.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.
The Teletubbies watch four boys playing with some piglets. The Tubbies have fun sitting at the table and laughing at the noise they make.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.

The Teletubbies finish up their toast in time to see Alex Pascall and some children go for a walk and sing Good Morning to everyone they meet. All the Teletubbies wanted to play with Dipsy, but Dipsy wants to dance.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy and his dad play basketball. The Tubbies are very careful not to drop their Tubby Toast, but when Tinky Winky has an accident, the Noo Noo tidies up.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
Today in Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies have special things to do. Andy Brown and some children drive through a safari park to see some monkeys.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.
Po looks after the Teletubbies' favourite things. The Teletubbies have fun watching some children making shadows.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.
The Tubbies are excited to see seven clouds appear in Teletubbyland. Some children learn about the number seven and in Teletubbyland, a voice trumpet rises and teaches the Tubbies to count to seven.
A chair appears in Teletubbyland and Laa-Laa has fun standing up and sitting down. The Teletubbies watch a little girl, Emily, riding her pony, Jester.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.
The Tubbies pop up to see some boys who live on a farm. The boys talk about their chicks. Dipsy looks out of the window.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.

Po & Laa-Laa burst out of the house for a Big Hug and then watch a group of children act out their story of a journey. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa wondered where Po was so they went to look. Laa-Laa finds Po lying asleep under a big tree.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.
Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.

The Teletubbies watch two children make a den. A carpet appears in Teletubbyland. First Laa-Laa steps on to the carpet and the off the carpet and then Po stands in the middle and then at the edge of the carpet.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.

Po brings the Tubbies out of the house to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the silly soppy soap. It's time for Po to have a wash with her Tubby Sponge and Noo Noo helps her.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
The Teletubbies watch some children have fun playing a guessing game. A book appears in Teletubbyland and Laa-Laa loves to count the rabbits.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
In Teletubbyland, some voice trumpets rise and make some funny animal noises. They baa like sheep, moo like cows, meow like cats and oink like pigs.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl visit her cousin to stay the night. The Teletubbies are very busy with their favourite things.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.

A voice trumpet rises and makes quacking sounds, which Dipsy finds very amusing. He joins the other Teletubbies to watch two children feeding some ducks. In Teletubbyland, Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep.
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
The Teletubbies watch a little boy with his grandad’s pigeons. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies go out to play. They play on the hills spinning around and waving their arms.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
Tinky Winky and Dipsy step in some mud. They join Laa-Laa and Po to watch a little girl polish her family’s shoes. A magical carpet appears in Teletubbyland.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.
The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl making breakfast for her mum. Laa-Laa and Po wake up and play a great game saying ‘Good Morning’ to each other.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.
The Teletubbies watch how some children who live on an island go to school by boat. A voice trumpet appears in Teletubbyland and the Teletubbies play a game called here and there.
The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.

The Teletubbies run around the house before watching some children paint in circles. Tinky Winky and Dipsy make some Tubby Custard, The Noo-noo tidies up all of Dipsy’s Tubby Custard, so Dipsy and Tinky Winky chase the Noo-noo.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.

The Teletubbies play a hide & seek game, before watching a little boy with his stick insects. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky saw a big cloud, Po saw a small cloud and Dipsy and Laa-Laa see two medium size clouds.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep
The Teletubbies dance through Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number five.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

In Teletubbyland, it's time for Tubby Toast, but there's no Tubby Toast for Laa‑Laa. She is very sad, so the other Tubbies share their extra toast with Laa-Laa. Some children learn about the number six.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.
Po walks up to say ‘Eh-oh’, then marches off again. She joins the other Teletubbies to see two children watching a herd of elephants in a safari park.
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.

The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa’s present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

The Teletubbies watch some children who are on a drive around a Game Park in South Africa. A trolley appears in Teletubbyland. Po wanted Tinky Winky to pull her in the trolley, but Tinky Winky was feeling tired.
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.
The Teletubbies and a group of children see Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty snake.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
A little boy’s daddy is a policeman, he shows us his uniform and badges. The Teletubbies are sitting at their table when they hear a funny noise.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.
